verdict.rationale: Belvo is an open-finance API platform, so a built-in assistant in its dashboard or docs is a fair thing to ask about, but the evidence shows no such assistant. The AI-related items are MCP servers for connecting external agents (Cursor, VS Code), a 'Copy for LLM' docs feature and an llms.txt file. These serve outside AI tools and are adjacent capabilities, not an assistant inside the product that users can delegate tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
